column1: # Per-file shard weights for the time-weighted CI shard map (SFN-863).
# weight = round(1e6 * max over targets of (file_elapsed / suite_total)).
# A share, not a duration, so one table serves Unix and Windows targets
# at different absolute speeds -- see the measured suite totals below.
# NOT target-invariant per file: a given file can score differently on
# each target (SFN-1223), and max-over-targets takes the larger own-suite
# share. A ranking signal, not a per-file cost model.
# Generated by scripts/aggregate_shard_weights.sh from ci-test-timing-* artifacts.
# Targets contributing: windows-x86_64(956 files, 13078s) linux-arm64(956 files, 6175s) macos-arm64(956 files, 6753s)
# Source: complete run 36129730322 JSONL sidecars (2026-09-25); the CI candidate ran before Windows shards finished.
# Rows moved to compiler/tests/nightly are omitted; target counts above describe the source artifacts.
# An unlisted file gets the median of this table, derived at load
# missing/unparseable table falls back to the alphabetical stride.
